_doc: Access groups an API key can be given (switches on /admin). A key can hold any combination. A meeting is readable by a key if ANY of its groups allows the meeting's (account, team). account "*" = every account. R2 folders are <account>-account/ (D15). Changing this file = restart the web app, no data moves.

member.label: Member
member.description: PM account meetings of the listed teams only (allow-list: misc, hr, one-on-one, operations, project-management, ethics-legal and any new team stay hidden)

admin.label: Admin (John)
admin.description: Every meeting in every account, including HR and 1:1
